workLog.action: Weighed the launcher-guard proposal in issue #3332 against documenting the failure mode, and shipped the documentation.
workLog.result: The issue proposed adding a file-existence guard to the generated bash and powershell launcher strings so a stale plugin root reports a restart remedy instead of a bare Errno 2. Rejected on measurement. The interpreter error already prints the full missing path, so the guard buys exactly one sentence: restart the session. Against that, it puts branching into the highest-blast-radius string in the repository, in a generated artifact, in two shell dialects, and it breaks the one-quoted-token invariant that tests/build_scripts/test_generate_hooks_runtime_contract.py relies on at five call sites. That is the argument ADR-006 makes against logic in workflow YAML, and the issue named it itself. The missing knowledge was never the path; it was that Copilot CLI holds the resolved plugin root for the process lifetime, so reinstalling without restarting does not help. That belongs in agent-harness-reference, whose stated scope already covers plugin roots, and it is now there with the stderr signature and two new description triggers so a search for the Errno 2 text lands on it.

learnings: Before building a diagnostic, read the message the failure already prints. Here it already carried the path, so the whole delta was one sentence of missing runtime-contract knowledge, which is a documentation shape, not a code shape.
